8-pose action sheet. Transparent-background PNG: the background is fully transparent (alpha channel). No white background, no checkerboard, no ground, no cast shadow, no scenery of any kind.
Two rows of 4, read left to right, top to bottom: 8 poses of one continuous action by the same character (the key poses and the in-between poses that connect them; each pose must flow from the one before). Leave clear gaps between all 8 poses; they must not touch or overlap. No grid lines, numbers, motion arcs or speed lines. The character is the same size in all 8 poses (one scale, no change in distance) and the whole body stays in the frame. In poses standing on the ground, the soles rest on the same horizontal line within each row; jumping or airborne poses are clearly above that line (at least half a body height off the ground). All 8 poses face the same direction (unless the action itself is a turn); anything worn on the back or held stays on the same side of the body throughout.

Action: the owl teacher demonstrates flying, facing right (three-quarter view toward the right), camera at eye level, the owl the same size in every pose; the 8 poses are one continuous action.

2 knees bent, body sinking, wings starting to open
3 wings spread wide up above the head, feet just leaving the ground
4 wings pushed down hard below the body, feet tucked up, airborne
5 wings spread wide up again, airborne, beak slightly raised proudly
6 wings half folded, feet reaching down to land
